name: Khai Doan Pagoda
kicker: Large city pagoda in Phan Boi Chau
summary: The large pagoda in the Phan Boi Chau area, with a wooden hall, yellow lanterns, and a white pavilion in the courtyard. Allow 30 to 45 minutes in the late afternoon. A donation may be asked. The amount is Check on arrival.
getThere: Phan Boi Chau, taxi or motorbike from the center
heroCaption: Wooden hall, yellow lanterns, and the white pavilion
body: Khải Đoan sits in the Phan Boi Chau area. The Buon Ma Thuot ward portal and Dak Lak Tourism both put it on a city day. Allow 30 to 45 minutes. Late afternoon is the softer light on the roof. A donation may be asked. The amount is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.

The courtyard is the wooden hall, the stair, and the white pavilion. Do not fly a drone unless the pagoda allows it. The prison on Tan Thuat and the museums on Y Ngong are separate stops, on their own tickets.

figures.caption: The stair up to the hall, with the pavilion behind
figures.alt: Carved stair and yellow lanterns at Khai Doan Pagoda, with a white pavilion in the courtyard

gettingThere: The pagoda is in the Phan Boi Chau area. From hotels around Nguyen Tat Thanh and Le Duan, take a taxi, Grab, or a motorbike. The Buon Ma Thuot ward portal and Dak Lak Tourism name the pagoda and do not print the minutes. The minutes are Check on arrival.
